# x402-url-canonicalizer

Deterministic URL canonicalization microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/canonicalize — paid

## Pricing
~0.003–0.008 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "url": "https://Example.COM:443/path?b=2&a=1#frag", "options?": { "removeFragment": true, "trailingSlash": "remove" } }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
